text.text_excerpt: Wow! I love this place! Before I even set foot in the door, The Saint Hotel wins me over immediately with their valet parking. I hate having to look everywhere for parking downtown or park in a lot and walk through sketchy areas in the heat. The valet guys are super nice and friendly here and made the experience painless. I think The Saint might rank up there with The Roosevelt for me, as far as "fancy feel" goes. The lobby is gorgeous and I stopped in here on a Sunday for a little "chill". There's a nice seating area with sofas right in the front of the lobby. There's also a nice bar, if you are interested in getting a drink. The rest of the lobby is huge and the people working here are ...

I recently stayed at The Saint with my sister for a few nights and loved it. The minute we walked in we knew we'd loved it because of the amazing decor and the amazing hospitality. Right from the first time we walked in, we felt so welcome with the doorman and the front desk girls. SUPER!!! FRIENDLY!!! The hotel lobby and entrance all looked cool with great paintings and decor. Just like their other locations, they have these oversized chairs that are great for taking fun pictures so before we even went up to see our room we already took a ton of cool pictures. The chairs make you feel so miniature. The hotel also has a really nice bar in the lobby. It's decorated with lots of red chandel...

Such a great hotel stay! The staff was super friendly and always greeted us as we came and went, making us feel really welcome. The location is perfect to go to either the French Quarter or the Warehouse District. Can't think of a better spot. Though, be aware, it's near some ongoing construction, so some of the views are less than would be desired, but hey, that's what they're working with right now. The rooms are really comfy and beautifully appointed. I love the cleanness of the white mixed with the pops of the cobalt blue and chandeliers that bring that vibrancy and edge.
